title: Biased draw with a diagonal direction and dist > radius/sqrt(2) lands outside the group radius — the candidate does NOT join the estate, contradicting the stated invariant
detail: dist is drawn in [3, radius] but the 4 diagonal compass dirs scale Euclidean distance by sqrt(2): with radius 5, diagonal draws at dist 4-5 land 5.66/7.07 tiles away — outside the derived view's <= r2 adjacency (growth.odin:187). ~1/3 of biased draws silently behave like isolated spawns; no guard clamps diagonal dist, and no test pins the join.
recommended_fix: Either clamp dist for diagonal dirs to floor(radius*isqrt inverse) / use dist*dist*(dir^2 sum) <= r2 when drawing, or correct the comment/test claims to state the biased candidate only lands within Chebyshev radius and may not join the derived cluster.

title: growth_groups block parsed with float-truncating jint, not jint_strict — a decimal value silently truncates and passes the range validation
evidence:
b.growth_groups.bias_prob_permille = jint(gobj, "bias_prob_permille", -1)
			b.growth_groups.min_members = jint(gobj, "min_members", -1)
			b.growth_groups.max_members = jint(gobj, "max_members", -1)
			b.growth_groups.radius_tiles = jint(gobj, "radius_tiles", -1)
			b.growth_groups.member_weight_permille = jint(gobj, "member_weight_permille", -1)   — and jint itself: `case json.Float:   return i32(x)` (catalog.odin:1133), vs the sibling: `b.cap_fraction_permille, _ = jint_strict(obj, "cap_fraction_permille", -1)` (catalog.odin:774)
detail: jint silently truncates json.Float, so "bias_prob_permille": 750.5 loads as 750 and passes the 1..999 check. The immediately-preceding 5.9 sibling uses jint_strict with a 'cap_fraction decimal' fail-fast test row; growth_groups has no decimal test row. ODN-10 integer-only bar is silently bendable here.
recommended_fix: Switch the five growth_groups reads to jint_strict (reject on float, like cap_fraction_permille) and add a decimal fail-fast test row for the block.

title: radius_tiles has no upper bound — an oversized radius silently merges all terminals into one derived cluster and makes biased dist draws exceed the connect span
detail: Every sibling knob gets both bounds (bias 1..999, member_weight 1..1000); radius gets only a floor. A hand-tuned radius of e.g. 500 loads clean: union-find merges the whole map into one 'estate' (the weight bonus applies map-wide, silently neutralizing the concentration knob) and biased distances up to 500 burn the bounded GROWTH_MAX_ATTEMPTS budget, silently stalling growth.
recommended_fix: Add an upper-bound check (e.g. radius_tiles <= some small multiple of the connect span or a fixed ceiling like 12) to the fail-fast validation, matching the block's both-bounds convention.
